title: Stacky geometry and logarithmic topology of transversely affine foliations
summary: We study the stacky and logarithmic-topological structures associated with transversely affine affine foliations. To such a foliation we attach its holonomy group and the corresponding quotient stack, which provides the natural geometric base for the multiplicative developing coordinate. Holomorphic and meromorphic reparametrisations are then identified with endomorphisms of this stack and of its compactification, yielding a geometric Singer-type theorem.
